Action plan

  1. Confirm within 2–4 weeks: task a hyperspectral satellite (EMIT / EnMAP / PRISMA / Tanager) or fly an OGI-camera drone survey over the flagged area.
  2. Install landfill-gas collection (vertical wells + header) on the flagged cell; at 60% capture this avoids ≈41,894 t CO₂e/yr (minimum estimate).
  3. Use the gas: ≈0.9 MW electric (7,697 MWh/yr, ≈₹3.8 crore/yr at ₹5.0/kWh); flare whatever the engine can't take.
  4. Register the avoided emissions for carbon credits: ≈$418,945/yr at $10.0/t.
  5. Interim: cover exposed waste and apply a biocover / compost layer on side slopes to oxidise methane; repair cracks and leachate seeps.
  6. Satellite sensitivity here: no plume size up to 40 t/h reached 50% detection — screening relies on hyperspectral / ground survey.
  7. Long term: continue legacy-waste bio-mining / remediation and divert organics (composting, biomethanation) so less methane is generated.

Method & assumptions

Sentinel-2 L1C (harmonized) 2 km chips; VayuNetra U-Net (SSL4EO-S12 ResNet-50, fine-tuned on MethaneSET + synthetic plumes), scene threshold 0.84; physics gate (B12-only dimming, wind alignment); IME emission rate with U_eff = 0.140·U10 + 1.111; ERA5-Land wind. Assumptions: gwp100=27.0, gwp20=79.7, capture_eff=0.6, flare_destruction=0.98, ch4_lhv_mj_per_kg=50.0, engine_eff=0.35, power_price_inr_per_kwh=5.0, carbon_price_usd_per_t=10.0, wind_rel_unc=0.3, calib_rel_unc=0.2. Satellite estimates are screening-grade and must be confirmed before enforcement or crediting.
